limits: No physical UART, RCC timing, ISR latency or DMA observation.
M4 image is a linked closure audit, not booted firmware; original byte helpers are explicitly supplied.
Serialized service requires exclusion between ISR/thread callers; no race-freedom claim.
PPC64 changes endian/data model for original core; no STM32 big-endian mode claim.
All execution uses assessor implementations, not learner artifacts.
